name: Brecilien Archer
subtitle: Watcher of the Woods
description: Unleash volleys of arrows to take down your foes.
lore: Hailing from a forested region of Avalon, Brecilien warriors practice a form of archery improved from that of the Realm’s already elite longbowmen. Wielding bows taller than themselves, they draw their bowstrings with impossible strength to deliver death at unimaginable distances. When fighting in units, they can fell entire battalions. On their own, a single Brecilien archer serves as a deadly sniper.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy.

skills.name: Swift Shot
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 140%ATK 3 times. Place [Sharpen I] on this hero for 1 turn.

skills.name: Woodland Volley
skills.description: Attack all enemies 260%ATK. Increase the duration of [Sharpen] on this hero by 1 turn.
